name: Spending by type
description: Every dollar of state spending (General, special, bond and federal funds) grouped by what it pays for. Each department program is assigned to one type of payment, so nothing is counted twice and the total matches the agency view. The grouping is this explorer’s, built on the official program structure; open any program to see the rule that placed it.
